title: Code and data for a unified component analysis of the best-fit strip-packing family
description: Zero-dependency Python reimplementations of fifteen best-fit and related constructive heuristics for two-dimensional strip packing, the configurable CCH engine, all experiment runners, benchmark instances, per-cell raw results (CSV), and the 120-instance prospective suite.
